vulnerability_analysis: The HuskyInu contract has an addBlacklist() function that is only callable by the owner. The owner can arbitrarily blacklist any address, preventing it from making transfers. This is a centralization risk and abuse of power vulnerability.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call addBlacklist() to blacklist a victim address, then verify the blacklist status is true.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call addBlacklist(victim_address, true). 4. Verify blacklist[victim_address] == true.
